Context: Terms and conditions:

## Terms and conditions:  
1. All eligible Government servants may avail LTC to visit any place in NER / A&N / J&K / Ladakh against the conversion of their one Home Town LTC in a four year block.
2. Government servants, whose Home Town and Headquarters / place of posting is the same, are not allowed the conversion.
3. The Government servant whose Hometown is situated in NER / A&N / J&K / Ladakh will also be allowed conversion of Hometown
